description: Code cleanup - unify API layer to use Service layer, extract shared CLI apiClient, slim down StateManager

tasks.title: Extract shared CLI apiClient to cli/api-client.ts
tasks.description: Create `packages/cli/src/cli/api-client.ts` with the shared `apiClient` function and `API_BASE` constant extracted from the current copy in issue.ts. Then update issue.ts, quick.ts, and project.ts to import from the shared module instead of defining locally.
acceptanceCriteria: cli/api-client.ts exists and exports apiClient function and API_BASE constant
cli/commands/issue.ts imports apiClient from ../api-client, no local apiClient definition
cli/commands/quick.ts imports apiClient from ../api-client, no local apiClient definition
cli/commands/project.ts imports apiClient from ../api-client, no local apiClient definition
No file contains duplicate API_BASE constant definition
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Pure mechanical extraction. The three copies are identical. Be careful about relative import paths — issue.ts and quick.ts and project.ts are all in cli/commands/ so the import is '../api-client'.

tasks.title: Add missing methods to IssueService with CommentRepo
tasks.description: Add CommentRepo to IssueService constructor and add methods: create(title, body, labels) with labels support, update(id, data) for title/body/labels, createComment(issueId, body), getCommentsByIssue(issueId). Change constructor to accept both IssueRepo and CommentRepo.
acceptanceCriteria: IssueService constructor accepts CommentRepo as second parameter
IssueService.create accepts labels parameter
IssueService.update(id, {title?, body?, labels?}) exists
IssueService.createComment(issueId, body) exists and returns Comment
IssueService.getCommentsByIssue(issueId) exists and returns Comment[]
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: IssueService currently only has IssueRepo. Need to add CommentRepo dependency. Look at StateManager for how these methods wrap repo calls.

tasks.title: Add cascade delete and getCurrentId to ProjectService
tasks.description: Add IssueRepo to ProjectService constructor for cascade delete. Update delete() to call issueRepo.deleteByProjectCascade before deleting project. Add getCurrentId() method that returns projectId string (not Project object) for places that need just the ID.
acceptanceCriteria: ProjectService constructor accepts IssueRepo as third parameter
ProjectService.delete cascades issue deletion via issueRepo.deleteByProjectCascade
ProjectService.getCurrentId() exists and returns string | null (just the ID from config)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: ProjectService currently only has ProjectRepo and ConfigRepo. getCurrent() returns Project|null but API layer often needs just the ID string. StateManager.getCurrentProjectId() returns string|null directly from config.

tasks.title: Refactor api/issues.ts to use IssueService and ProjectService
tasks.description: Change createIssueRoutes to accept issueService and projectService instead of stateManager. Replace stateManager CRUD calls with service calls: createIssue→issueService.create, getIssueByNumber→issueService.getByNumber, updateIssueStage→issueService.transitionToStage, createComment→issueService.createComment, getCommentsByIssue→issueService.getCommentsByIssue. Replace getCurrentProjectId calls with projectService.getCurrentId(). Keep stateManager only for repo getters passed to agentRunner.
acceptanceCriteria: createIssueRoutes signature takes issueService and projectService, not stateManager
No stateManager.createIssue, stateManager.getIssueByNumber, stateManager.updateIssueStage, stateManager.createComment, stateManager.getCommentsByIssue calls
No stateManager.getCurrentProjectId calls (use projectService.getCurrentId())
stateManager only appears for repo getters (getIssueRepo, getCommentRepo) passed to agentRunner

All endpoints still work: GET /api/issues, POST /api/issues, GET /api/issues/:number, PATCH /api/issues/:number, POST /api/issues/:number/comments, POST /api/issues/:number/start, POST /api/issues/:number/close, POST /api/issues/:number/reopen, POST /api/issues/:number/approve
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is the biggest task. The start/approve endpoints still need stateManager.getIssueRepo() and stateManager.getCommentRepo() for passing to agentRunner — that's fine per design D4. Focus on replacing CRUD calls, not orchestration.

tasks.title: Refactor api/projects.ts to use ProjectService
tasks.description: Change createProjectRoutes to accept projectService instead of stateManager. Replace all stateManager calls with projectService calls: loadProjects→projectService.getAll, getProjectByName→projectService.getByName, saveProject→projectService.create, deleteProject→projectService.delete, setCurrentProjectId→projectService.setCurrent.
acceptanceCriteria: createProjectRoutes signature takes projectService, not stateManager
No stateManager calls in api/projects.ts
GET /api/projects works
POST /api/projects works
DELETE /api/projects/:name works
POST /api/projects/:name/use works
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: ProjectService already has getAll, getByName, create. Delete now has cascade. setCurrentByName is cleaner than current two-step.

tasks.title: Refactor api/status.ts and api/labels.ts to use Services
tasks.description: Update api/status.ts to accept projectService and issueService instead of stateManager. Replace stateManager calls: loadProjects→projectService.getAll, loadIssues→issueService.getByProject, getProjectById→projectService.getById, getCurrentProjectId→projectService.getCurrentId. Update api/labels.ts similarly.
acceptanceCriteria: createStatusRoutes signature takes projectService and issueService, not stateManager
createLabelRoutes signature takes projectService, not stateManager
No stateManager.loadProjects, stateManager.loadIssues, stateManager.getProjectById, stateManager.getCurrentProjectId in status.ts
No stateManager.getCurrentProjectId, stateManager.getLabels in labels.ts
GET /api/status works (both with and without ?all=true)
GET /api/labels works
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: labels.ts uses getLabels which returns all labels for a project — this might need a new method in IssueService or we can query via repo. status.ts does cross-domain aggregation which is the legitimate use case for having both services.

tasks.title: Update server/index.ts to inject Services into routes
tasks.description: Update server/index.ts to create IssueService and ProjectService instances with proper repo injection and pass them to all route factories. IssueService needs IssueRepo and CommentRepo. ProjectService needs ProjectRepo, ConfigRepo, and IssueRepo (for cascade delete).
acceptanceCriteria: server/index.ts creates IssueService with IssueRepo and CommentRepo
server/index.ts creates ProjectService with ProjectRepo, ConfigRepo, and IssueRepo
createIssueRoutes receives issueService, projectService, and stateManager (for repo getters)
createProjectRoutes receives projectService
createStatusRoutes receives projectService and issueService
createLabelRoutes receives projectService
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This wires everything together. StateManager is still needed for creating repos and passing to routes that need repo getters.

tasks.title: Remove redundant CRUD methods from StateManager
tasks.description: Remove all CRUD methods from StateManager that are now handled by Services: createIssue, getIssueByNumber, updateIssueStage, updateIssueStatus, getCommentsByIssue, createComment, getLabels, loadProjects, loadIssues, getProjectById, getProjectByName, saveProject, deleteProject, getCurrentProjectId, setCurrentProjectId, clearCurrentProject, updateIssueLabels, addIssueLabel, removeIssueLabel. Keep only: getProjectRepo, getIssueRepo, getCommentRepo, getConfigRepo, getLabelRepo, isInitialized.
acceptanceCriteria: StateManager only has repo getters (getProjectRepo, getIssueRepo, getCommentRepo, getConfigRepo, getLabelRepo) and isInitialized
No compile errors from removed methods
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Final step — after all consumers migrated, removing these methods should cause zero compile errors.
